citation.authors: Perry PK, Cook-Bolden FE, Rahman Z, Jones E et al
citation.journal: Journal of the American Academy of Dermatology

record.design: Review of PFB and its pathogenesis
record.finding: PFB is most often seen in men and women of African American and Hispanic origin who have tightly curled hair and who shave or tweeze frequently. The authors state follicle shape, hair cuticle and direction of hair growth each play a role, and that prevention and early intervention are the mainstays; no treatment is completely curative.
